headline: Air defences intercepted and destroyed three Ansar Allah cruise missiles launched toward the Riyadh region
dek: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- the interception] The Saudi-led coalition said its air defences intercepted and destroyed three cruise missiles launched by Yemen's Ansar Allah toward the Riyadh region, before they reached their targets. Coalition spokesman Maj.
sources: Saudi-led coalition, spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Maliki (via Saudi Gazette breaking message; coalition statement)
fault_line: Riyadh residents heard the blasts but got no alert -- is the shield working, or is the capital learning to live under fire?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- the interception] The Saudi-led coalition said its air defences intercepted and destroyed three cruise missiles launched by Yemen's Ansar Allah toward the Riyadh region, before they reached their targets. Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Maliki announced the interception. [VERIFIED FACT -- distinct from Tuesday] Tuesday Nov 10's event was a DIFFERENT salvo: 1 ballistic + 1 cruise missile toward Riyadh + 1 ballistic missile toward the south (TRT World, Nov 10 03:02Z). Today's claim is THREE CRUISE missiles, all toward the Riyadh region. Do not combine the figures. [UNVERIFIED -- damage] No details on launch locations, intended targets, debris, damage or casualties; the Ansar Allah have not claimed the launches (UrduPoint notes this explicitly).
sections.what_verified: 1 tiered family: the Saudi-led coalition statement itself (T1, STATE SA) -- the primary source of its own claim (primary_source_single_family: true). Turkiye Today, Arab Times Online, CGTN, UrduPoint and CryptoBriefing/FirstSquawk carry the announcement but have NO declared tier in the registry and do not count.
sections.what_disputed: No independent verification; the Ansar Allah have not claimed responsibility for these launches; no debris, damage or casualty detail. Riyadh residents' social posts report hearing explosions around Exit 13 while others heard nothing and no alerts fired (zeitgeist run, in-window IG post 2.2K likes / 350 comments) -- the interception claim cannot be confirmed from the ground. Tuesday's separate 3-missile event is a conflation risk (UrduPoint warns explicitly against treating the two days' figures as one event).
sections.why_matters: Second night in a row: three cruise missiles at Riyadh -- and this time residents are asking why the alarms never sounded.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (AJ liveblog 14:08 GMT = 18:08 ; Turkiye Today 17:33+03 = 18:33 ; Arab Times 17:10+03 = 18:10 ; CGTN 21:59+08 = 17:59 ) -- Saudi-led coalition: air defences intercepted and destroyed three Ansar Allah cruise missiles launched toward the Riyadh region

totw_analysis: Our read: Second night in a row: three cruise missiles at Riyadh -- and this time residents are asking why the alarms never sounded. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Riyadh residents heard the blasts but got no alert -- is the shield working, or is the capital learning to live under fire?
